WHAT WOULD YOU DO?

In your role as a Data Engineer you provide insights and solutions for complex data problems in order to implement end-to-end data solutions. You are responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the Data Warehouse and ETL infrastructure, where you will transform data into useful data formats for analysis. As a Data Engineer you will come across many varied and challenging projects: ranging from the design and implementation of the data warehouse and the development of ETL to the implementation and maintenance of reports and dashboards.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You understand the needs of the customer and can easily handle complex data environments.
• You are focused on collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
• You have strong communication skills and always strive for the best solution.
• You have an inquisitive mind and eager to learn.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French and have a strong knowledge of English.

WHAT ABOUT YOUR TECHNICAL SKILLS?

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with ETL and Data pipelines to integrate multiple data sources
• Experience with Data Warehouse environments
• Insights in setting up ETL processes and Data Flows
• Development and testing of ETL jobs
• Solid programming skills and SQL querying experience
• Hands-on experience with ETL tools is a plus
• Knowledge of Data Vault, Kimball is a plus
• Knowledge of Oracle, Google BigQuery or Microsoft Azure is a plus

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

• Prepare and process supplier payments on time
• Handle payments through Isabel and ensure proper controls
• Follow up on supplier payment reminders

• Manage bank transactions and financial documentation

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken). Dutch is a strong plus
• Solid knowledge of Belgian accounting and VAT regulations
• Comfortable working with ERP systems, payment tools and reconciliation processes
• Autonomous, structured, detail-oriented and proactive
• Strong team player with good communication and prioritization skills

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:
	
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.	
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.	
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.	
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.	
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.	
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!
	
• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.	
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.	
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.	
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.	
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.	
• You have basic PC skills.	
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.	
• You speak good Dutch or English.

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.

• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).	
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:
	
• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.	
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.	
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.	
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.

• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

It's unique modular product system, developed over several decades, is one of our key success factors. It is an integral part of our flexible approach and lies at the heart of our business model.

You will independently perform maintenance and repair work on our fleet of vehicles, including trucks and buses.
You'll work with a premium brand, and we’ll turn you into a true specialist in your field!

You’ll join a close team of experienced technicians, all working together toward one goal: providing fast and efficient service to our customers.

•

•

•

With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.	
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:
	
• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.	
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.	
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.	
• Basic knowledge of electricity.	
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.	
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Profile Description

The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.

Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

We are primarily looking for candidates who:
	
• Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).	
• Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.	
• Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.	
• Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.	
• Work accurately and pay attention to safety.	
• Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.	
• Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.
